csv_project_name: Engrg for New Portsmouth Seacoast Greenway Trailhead Facil
csv_scope_of_work: The project is intended to create two trailhead facilities located on city-owned land that will connect users to the New Hampshire Seacoast Greenway; one located along Borthwick Avenue and another on Banfield Road that will include paved parking areas for trail users, concrete pads and enclosures for portable restrooms, bicycle racks, trailhead kiosks and wayfinding signage, landscaping and a seating area. The trailheads will be located at 445 Borthwick Ave. and 850 Banfield Road. Engineering and design services for two trailhead facilities on City-owned parcels: a 17.5-acre site located at 445 Borthwick Avenue and a 7-acre site located at 850 Banfield Road. These facilities will provide access to the New Hampshire Seacoast Greenway. Each trailhead will include paved parking areas for trail users, concrete pads and enclosures for portable restrooms, bicycle racks, accommodation for horses and horse trailers, railhead kiosks and wayfinding signage, landscaping and a seating area.
